# Generated by Manarouter (POST /api/gpu/apply) for provider `rental-mana-modal-qwen3-8-27b-uncensored-fp8`.
#
# Deploy it with:
#     modal deploy modal_app.py
#
# Modal prints the endpoint URL on deploy. Paste that URL into the provider's base URL in the
# panel; Manarouter cannot know it in advance because Modal mints it per app.
import subprocess

import modal

APP_NAME = "manarouter-rental-mana-modal-qwen3-8-27b-uncensored-fp8"
MODEL = "orcarouter/Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-FP8"
GPU = "RTX-PRO-6000"
SCALEDOWN_WINDOW = 60
MAX_MODEL_LEN = 262144
MAX_NUM_SEQS = 6

app = modal.App(APP_NAME)

# The vLLM server image. `add_python=None` keeps the image's own entrypoint off the path so the
# process this function starts is the only server on the port.
image = modal.Image.from_registry("vllm/vllm-openai:latest", add_python=None)


@app.function(
    image=image,
    gpu=GPU,
    scaledown_window=SCALEDOWN_WINDOW,
    timeout=60 * 60,
)
@modal.concurrent(max_inputs=MAX_NUM_SEQS)
@modal.web_server(port=8000, startup_timeout=60 * 20)
def serve() -> None:
    args = [
        "vllm",
        "serve",
        MODEL,
        "--host",
        "0.0.0.0",
        "--port",
        "8000",
        "--served-model-name",
        MODEL,
        "--quantization",
        "fp8",
        "--kv-cache-dtype",
        "fp8",
        "--max-model-len",
        "262144",
        "--max-num-seqs",
        "6",
    ]
    subprocess.Popen(args)
